name: Titanium.UI.Android.ProgressIndicator
summary: A progress dialog or a horizontal progress bar in the title of the window.
description:
| Android |
| ------- |
| ![Android](./progressindicator_android.png) |

A progress indicator can be used to show the progress of an operation in the UI to let the
user know that some action is taking place. It is used to indicate an ongoing activity of
determinate or indeterminate length.

Use the [Titanium.UI.Android.createProgressIndicator](api:Titanium.UI.Android#createProgressIndicator) method or **`<ProgressIndicator>`** Alloy
element to create a progress indicator.

A progress indicator can be either a progress dialog or a horizontal progress bar in the title
of the window. The progress dialog is a modal dialog that blocks the UI. See also:
[Titanium.UI.Android.PROGRESS_INDICATOR_DIALOG](api:Titanium.UI.Android#PROGRESS_INDICATOR_DIALOG),
[Titanium.UI.Android.PROGRESS_INDICATOR_STATUS_BAR](api:Titanium.UI.Android#PROGRESS_INDICATOR_STATUS_BAR).

**NOTE:** [Titanium.UI.Android.PROGRESS_INDICATOR_STATUS_BAR](api:Titanium.UI.Android#PROGRESS_INDICATOR_STATUS_BAR) does not work anymore on devices
running Android 4.4+ since the underlying API was deprecated and removed by Google. See
[TIMOB-27312](https://jira-archive.titaniumsdk.com/TIMOB-27312) for more details.

Calling [Titanium.UI.Android.ProgressIndicator.show](api:Titanium.UI.Android.ProgressIndicator#show) displays the indicator,
and calling [Titanium.UI.Android.ProgressIndicator.hide](api:Titanium.UI.Android.ProgressIndicator#hide) removes it.

Alloy XML Markup

properties.name: cancelable
properties.summary: When `true` allows the user to cancel the progress dialog by pressing the BACK button.

properties.name: canceledOnTouchOutside
properties.summary: When `cancelable` is set to `true` and this is set to `true`, the dialog is canceled when touched outside the window's bounds.

properties.name: max
properties.summary: Maximum value of the progress bar.

properties.name: messageid
properties.summary: Key identifying a string in the locale file to use for the message text.
properties.description: Only one of `message` or `messageid` should be specified.

properties.name: min
properties.summary: Minimum value of the progress bar.

methods.name: hide
methods.summary: Hides the progress indicator and stops the animation.

methods.name: show
methods.summary: Shows the progress indicator and starts the animation.

events.name: cancel
events.summary: Fired when the user has canceled the progress indicator dialog.
events.description:
The user triggers this event by pressing the BACK button when the dialog is visible.
The dialog will be hidden and this event dispatched.
